## Why

The reviewer reported (tool feedback, run ork-20261126-022730-61cc, item S614) that its own full `go test ./...` run exited 1, but `internal/daemon` stderr filled the output and hid the `--- FAIL` line. Pipes and redirects are denied, so it could not filter the output.

The owner decided (adj 646, key `reviewer.round-check-evidence`, Jon chose "Round result section", 2026-11-27) that the reviewer gets the same `## Ork round check result` section the gate gets. The gate section is built inline in `internal/engine/round.go:674-694` and carries the round, command, log name, exit status and the captured log, including failing lines. Round checks run before review (`checks` state, `internal/engine/states.go:347-375`), so the record already holds the log when the reviewer starts. The reviewer brief line at `internal/engine/brief.go:441` also changes to point at that section.

Owner decision, 2026-11-27: adj 646.
